messages:
ashok: Heads up — CI perf alert on master after merge of #4521. Large spike in kernel compiles and CPU/GPU warmup. Observed 3x P95 token latency on small-batch jobs. Anyone seen this locally? :eyes:

maria: saw regressions in canary last night, but thought it was noise. which jobs/commit?

ashok: job link: https://ci.redwood/jenkins/job/perf_master/1234 log attached. Merge SHA: 8f3a2b4. Root cause looks like new autotuner change that flips select heuristics for small-batch int8.

jon: running bisect now. quick repro steps?

sam: repro on devbox: checkout master@8f3a2b4, build runtime, run:
```
./bin/servetest --model llama-13b --batch-size 1 --dtype int8 --seq 128 --profile
```
It triggers a compilation burst and GPU memory spikes.

ci-bot: perf-checker: failure detected in perf_master/1234 — p95 increased 2.9x, compile count +720% in 10m window. See artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/1234/

jon: bisect result: commit 8f3a2b4 introduced change to autotune score weighting. Reproducer link: gist...

maria: profiler snapshot (trimmed):
```
CompileScheduler::enqueue(): 0.4s -> 1.9s (per-request)
kernel_select(): preferentially picked 'fast-path-v2' for short seq
KVCache::invalidate_range(): spike correlated with compile completions
```
Memory timeline shows repeated cache flushes after each compiled kernel landed.

ashok: sounds like wrong pick causes many variants to be compiled then cached, evicting KV entries and causing regen -> compile wave. Can we pin heuristic to previous behavior as hotfix?

jon: proposed rollback commit: revert 8f3a2b4 (PR #4521). I can open a revert PR now. Alternatively, add a guard to suppress autotune flips for batch-size<=2.

sam: confirmed locally that adding guard fixes perf: p95 back to baseline, compile count normal. Patch in branch `hotfix/avoid-hotflip`.

eng-oncall: can we hold the release/rollout? I'm putting the canary on hold and pausing autoscaling for dedicated pools. :lock:

maria: open revert PR and tag @infra for canary pause. Also want a short-term telemetry alert to watch compile rates.

jon: opened PR #4560 (revert 8f3a2b4) — https://git.redwood/pr/4560 — assigning @maria @ashok for review. Scheduling rollbacks now.

ashok: thanks. follow-up: let's add unit test that simulates small-batch seq distributions to prevent regressions.

ci-bot: noted. creating perf regression ticket T-2198 and adding baseline artifacts.

maria: :thumbsup:
